scope: Three regional airports and five main terminal markers, including a representative Rokko Island terminal complex. Selected destinations, not a complete schedule or traffic ranking.
locations: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; representative feature centers from sources/originals/transport-osm.json
routeGeometry: Authored schematic between OSM terminal centers with offshore control points. Not AIS/GPS/navigation data.
routeChecks: Official airport indexed flight listings and Kobe City ferry terminal guide reviewed; official Bay Shuttle boarding guide reviewed. Check operators for current schedules.
